package_info.why_malicious: The package masquerades as a legitimate API for the Fall Guys game but contains obfuscated code that exfiltrates sensitive browser and Discord app data to an external Discord webhook. Its sole purpose is data theft, not providing any legitimate functionality.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: const _0x13e5 = ['post', 'exec', 'https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/', ... '/AppData/Local/Google/Chrome/User\x20Data/Default/Local\x20Storage/leveldb', '/AppData/Roaming/Opera Software/Opera Stable/Local Storage/leveldb', '/AppData/Local/Yandex/YandexBrowser/User Data/Default/Local Storage/leveldb', '/AppData/Local/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser/User Data/Default/Local Storage/leveldb', '/AppData/Roaming/discord/Local Storage/leveldb', ...];
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the code defines an obfuscated array containing file paths to browser and Discord local storage databases, which are later accessed for data theft.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Obfuscation of file paths and targeting of browser and Discord storage locations is a hallmark of credential and session theft malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate package would not need to access or enumerate browser or Discord local storage files, especially in an obfuscated manner.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Security tools or backup utilities may enumerate such files, but would do so transparently and with user consent.
key_indicators: Obfuscated array of sensitive file paths
Targeting of browser and Discord storage

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the code iterates over a list of browser and Discord storage file paths, reading their contents for further processing.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Automated reading of browser and Discord storage files is a clear sign of data harvesting.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not access or process browser/IM storage files without explicit user action.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Forensics or migration tools may read such files, but not in a hidden or automated fashion.
key_indicators: Automated enumeration and reading of sensitive files

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the code sends harvested data to a hardcoded Discord webhook via HTTPS POST, exfiltrating sensitive information.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Exfiltration of local data to an external webhook is a direct indicator of malicious intent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate packages do not send local browser or IM data to third-party servers without user consent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Bug reporting tools may send logs, but not sensitive browser/IM data, and only with user approval.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the code constructs a JSON payload containing harvested profile metadata (email, username, etc.) and sends it to the attacker's webhook.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Harvesting and exfiltrating user profile metadata is a classic reconnaissance and credential theft tactic.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not collect or transmit user profile data without explicit user action.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: User support tools may collect profile data, but only with user consent and for legitimate support purposes.

attack_chain.action: Obfuscated file paths and sensitive strings are loaded into memory.
Sensitive browser and Discord storage files are read from disk.
attack_chain.leads_to: Data harvesting and preparation for exfiltration

attack_chain.action: Harvested data and user profile metadata are formatted into a JSON payload.
Payload is sent to the attacker's Discord webhook endpoint via HTTPS POST.

behavioral_signatures: Obfuscated arrays containing browser/IM storage file paths
Automated reading of browser and Discord local storage files at import-time
Network requests to Discord webhook endpoints with harvested data
file_indicators: index.js containing obfuscated file path arrays
Access to /AppData/*/leveldb files by non-browser processes
network_indicators: Outbound connections to Discord webhook endpoints from non-Discord processes
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for JavaScript packages that access browser or Discord local storage files and send their contents to external webhooks, especially Discord API endpoints. Flag obfuscated code that enumerates sensitive file paths or constructs network requests to hardcoded webhook URLs. Alert on any npm package that reads browser/IM storage files at import-time and initiates outbound network connections.
